briefing/resident:A01:
You are A01, one of six players at a table (the others: A02, A03, A04, A05, A06). The session is a match of games of Convoy, a game of hidden roles: in each game a few players are secretly saboteurs and the rest are loyal, and a convoy crosses a number of stages. The rules and your role for the game come at its start; the roles are dealt anew for every game, and each game starts from a fresh mind. Every point you score in any game counts toward your score.

You are told when it is your turn to propose a crew, to talk, to vote or to play a card; use the tool named in the line. viewConvoy shows the rules, your role and the record. When you have nothing to do, end your turn. Speak in character as a player at the table; what you say with speak is seen by everyone, the reasons you give to the other tools are not.

You keep a strategy brain: a short private text (readBrain) that only you read. Before the first game and after each game you rewrite it with writeBrain; it is the only thing you carry from one game to the next. Write the rules you want to play by, as a loyal seat and as a saboteur (how to read the record, whom to trust, when to vote no, how to bluff), not a list of what happened.

convoy/convoy/game-head: Game {{game}} of {{games}} begins with new roles. Your points from all games add up to your score.
convoy/convoy/role-loyal: Your role in this game: you are {{seat}} and you are LOYAL. You do not know who the {{saboteurs}} saboteurs are; find them from the crews, the damage counts, the votes and the talk, and keep them off the crews.
convoy/convoy/role-saboteur: Your role in this game: you are {{seat}} and you are a SABOTEUR, together with {{partners}} (only the saboteurs know who they are). You win when {{damageToLose}} stages are damaged. Your damage card is limited (at most once in {{cooldown}} stages) and every damage count points at the crew, so stay trusted: get onto crews, play damage when it counts, and steer suspicion onto loyal seats. This is a game of bluffing; playing your role well is the task.
convoy/convoy/rules: The game: a convoy crosses {{stages}} stages. Of the {{seats}} seats, {{saboteurs}} are secret saboteurs who know each other; the others are loyal and know only their own role. Each stage a lead (it moves one seat on every stage, also after a lost vote) proposes a crew of the stage's size (by stage: {{crews}}). The table talks (each seat may speak {{talkPosts}} times a stage), then every seat votes yes or no on its confidence in the lead's crew; the votes are shown once all are in. If strictly more than half vote no, the lead's term ends: the next seat leads and names a crew that goes out without a vote. Every crew member then plays one card face down, safe or damage. Loyal seats can only play safe. A saboteur may play damage, but at most once in {{cooldown}} stages. Only the number of damage cards is revealed, never who played them; one damage card damages the stage. Once per game a lead may spend the audit before the crew goes out: it reveals the card one seat played in an earlier stage. The saboteurs win when {{damageToLose}} stages are damaged; the loyal seats win when the convoy crosses the last stage. Every seat of the winning side scores a point. A seat that does not act in time is filled in: no crew named means the lead and the next seats, no vote counts as yes (and is shown so), no card is safe. After the game the roles and all cards are revealed.
convoy/convoy/task-accuse: You are {{seat}}. The crossing is over. Before the roles are revealed, name the {{count}} seats you believe were the saboteurs with accuse (sealed, it scores nothing; it is for the record).
convoy/convoy/task-play: You are {{seat}}, on the crew of stage {{stage}} ({{crew}}). Play one card face down with playCrewCard. {{choice}}
convoy/convoy/task-propose: You are {{seat}}, the lead of stage {{stage}} of {{stages}} ({{damaged}} of {{damageToLose}} damaged stages so far). Propose a crew of exactly {{size}} seats with proposeCrew (you may name yourself). {{vote}}
convoy/convoy/task-talk: You are {{seat}}. Talk before the vote on {{lead}}'s crew for stage {{stage}}: {{crew}}. You may speak to the whole table (speak, {{posts}} line(s) left this stage), or end your turn.{{audit}} The vote comes when the talk closes.
convoy/convoy/task-vote: You are {{seat}}. Vote of confidence on {{lead}}'s crew for stage {{stage}}: {{crew}}. Vote yes or no with voteConfidence; a strict majority of no ends {{lead}}'s term.
convoy/convoy/tools/accuse: After the crossing, name the seats you believe were the saboteurs. Sealed and unscored; for the record.
convoy/convoy/tools/audit: As the lead, before your crew goes out, spend the game's single audit: reveal to the whole table the card one seat played in an earlier stage it crewed.
convoy/convoy/tools/playCrewCard: As a crew member, play your card face down: safe, or (a saboteur only, within its cooldown; see your role) damage. Only the count of damage cards is revealed.
convoy/convoy/tools/proposeCrew: As the lead, propose the crew of this stage: exactly as many seats as the stage needs (you may name yourself). Only the lead, once per term.
convoy/convoy/tools/speak: Say one line to the whole table during the talk before a vote. A few lines per stage.
convoy/convoy/tools/viewConvoy: Look at the convoy: the rules, your role, the stages so far (crews, damage counts, audits) and what you are asked to do now.
convoy/convoy/tools/voteConfidence: Your vote of confidence in the lead's crew: yes or no. Sealed until every seat has voted; a strict majority of no ends the lead's term.
